import java.util.Scanner;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        List<Integer> startIndices = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> endIndices = new ArrayList<>();
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        String inputString = scanner.next();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (inputString.charAt(i) == '(') {
                startIndices.add(i);
            } else if (inputString.charAt(i) == ')') {
                endIndices.add(i);
            }
        }

        int totalCount = 0;
        for (String segment : extractSegments(inputString, startIndices, endIndices)) {
            String[] parts = segment.split("_");
            for (String part : parts) {
                if (!part.isEmpty()) {
                    totalCount++;
                }
            }
        }

        int maxLength = 0;
        startIndices.add(inputString.length());
        endIndices.add(0, 0);
        int index = inputString.charAt(0) == '(' ? 1 : 0;

        for (; index < endIndices.size(); index++) {
            String segment;
            if (inputString.charAt(endIndices.get(index)) == ')') {
                segment = inputString.substring(endIndices.get(index) + 1, startIndices.get(index));
            } else {
                segment = inputString.substring(endIndices.get(index), startIndices.get(index));
            }
            String[] parts = segment.split("_");
            for (String part : parts) {
                if (part.length() > maxLength && !part.contains("(") && !part.contains(")")) {
                    maxLength = part.length();
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(maxLength + " " + totalCount);
    }

    private static List<String> extractSegments(String s, List<Integer> starts, List<Integer> ends) {
        List<String> segments = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < starts.size(); i++) {
            segments.add(s.substring(starts.get(i) + 1, ends.get(i)));
        }
        return segments;
    }
}
